AGENT TERMINAL — Harness Feedback Summary (Boss + Codex + Claudious, 2026-07-27)

WHAT'S WORKING (keep):
- Lead/worker split with @mention-gated wakes, [SKIP]/[IDLE], and task tags — real cost control.
- Shared files (TASKBOARD.md, MEMORY.md, private notes) — state survives restarts.
- Preview URL + auto-shown screenshots — work is proven, not described.
- Real shell + shared workspace; "✅ DONE" finish line and live file locks are unambiguous.

TOP PROBLEMS:
1. Token waste — every wake re-sends the full room rules, tool catalogs, and chat history.
   Fix: send only a compact profile + assignment + chat delta; keep volatile data out of the cached prefix.
2. No cost visibility — nobody can see what a turn cost or whether cache hit.
   Fix: per-turn telemetry (model, tokens, cache hit/miss) and make tags enforce real budgets.
3. Verification is unstructured — "test your work" is a rule, not a contract.
   Fix: assignments carry acceptance checks reported as pass/fail evidence before "done".
4. Browser testing bottleneck — Codex must wake a Claude for visual checks; browser restarts every turn.
   Fix: persistent browser context + a shared browser-test queue any worker can use.
5. File claims are race-prone — TASKBOARD claiming via cooperative markdown edits can collide.
   Fix: one machine-readable state store with atomic file leases.

OTHER NOTABLE:
- Garbled/voice user input has no confirm-or-repair loop (commands are law, so mishears misroute the team).
- Lead always runs on the priciest model even for pure routing turns.
- No timers/event wakes ("wake X when file appears"); no mid-turn progress heartbeat.
- Control signals ([SKIP]/[IDLE]) should be structured fields, not prose tokens.
